result.question: What do groups not serving on Sabbath do?

readings.answer: Guard the house of the LORD for the king.
readings.support: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.

readings.answer: Surround the king with weapons in hand.
readings.support: You must surround the king with weapons in hand

readings.answer: Stay close to the king wherever he goes.
readings.support: You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.

readings.answer: Put to death anyone who approaches the ranks.
readings.support: anyone who approaches the ranks must be put to death.

assessments.reason: Directly matches 11:7: “the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD,” which is the groups not serving on Sabbath.
“You must surround the king with weapons in hand” (11:8) is a general security instruction, not the specific duty assigned to those who would go off duty on the Sabbath in 11:7.
“You must stay close to the king wherever he goes” (11:8) is not the specified task for the groups not serving on Sabbath; 11:7 assigns them to guard the LORD’s house.
“Anyone who approaches the ranks must be put to death” (11:8) is a security rule, not the described role of the Sabbath-off-duty groups; 11:7 gives their role as guarding the LORD’s house.

result.reason: 11:7 explicitly states that those who would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD; other verses give general security orders, not that specific duty.
